youtube_title: Jesus... He Cheated And Still Got The Higher Marks | Psalm 37:7 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... he copied in the exam and still got higher marks than me. I studied every night.

He studied every night. His classmate copied and still got the higher marks.

Him: Jesus... he copied in the exam and still got higher marks than me. I studied every night. 😠

Him: I didn't cheat because of You. And now I'm the one who looks stupid.

Jesus: You're angry because it's unfair. It is unfair. I saw every night you studied.

Him: Then why does doing the right thing feel like losing?

Jesus: Because marks only count one paper. I count who you are becoming. He won a number. You kept yourself.

Him: It still hurts when the results go up on the board.

Jesus: It will, for a while. But one day you'll stand somewhere you couldn't have reached by copying.

"Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes."
Psalm 37:7 (BSB)

Jesus: Keep your hands clean. Let Me handle the scoreboard.
